calculation_handling.description: For a building permit application filed before July 22, 2022, the listed current bicycle parking regulations do not prevent the project if it complies with the former Chapter 970 clauses and approved minor variances.
calculation_handling.gaps: Permit filing dates are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For a building permit application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025, the listed current bicycle parking regulations do not prevent the project if it complies with the former Chapter 970 clauses and approved minor variances.
calculation_handling.gaps: Permit filing dates are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Defines an application for a building permit as one meeting Article I of Chapter 363 of the City of Toronto Municipal Code.

230.90.15.1(1).explanation: Current bicycle parking rules do not block a project whose building permit application was filed before July 22, 2022, as long as it follows the earlier Chapter 970 bicycle parking clauses (and any approved minor variances).

230.90.15.1(2).explanation: The same relief applies to building permit applications filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, using the earlier Chapter 970 clauses.

230.90.15.1(3).explanation: An application for a building permit here means one that meets the requirements of Article I (Building Permits) of Chapter 363 of the City of Toronto Municipal Code.
